title: Факторный анализ
semantics: Correlation-matrix PCA of complete finite continuous Integer/Real features. parameters.factor_analysis supplies the full features set, fixed factors and rotation none. New nodes require all three; existing omitted settings persist. Execute trains/retrains current input, then executes; ordinary native activation applies the saved model. Read ports 0 (scores and original fields) and 1 (ColumnName, ColumnDisplayName, loadings). P feature columns Factor1..FactorP exist even with K<P: unused scores NULL, unused loadings zero. Scores use population-SD normalization. Preserve original values and rows; explicit output mappings with autosync=false are needed for stable field order after reopen. Constants, missing training features, rank-deficient inputs, automatic selection, rotations and saved-model apply are outside this slice.

parameter_schema.description: Parameters for research.factor_analysis / pca_fixed. Do not pass fields belonging to another node type.

factor_analysis.description: PCA of complete finite continuous numeric features, fixed count, no rotation. New nodes require features, factors and rotation; existing omission preserves supported settings. Execute trains/retrains current input, then executes and reads both ports. NULL training, constants and rank-deficient inputs are outside this slice.

items.description: Exact technical name of a continuous Integer/Real input field; never its display label.

features.description: Complete selected feature set in input-field order. Row identifiers and pass-through text must not be selected. On existing nodes the supplied list replaces all feature roles.

factors.description: Fixed number of factors, at most the selected feature count and observed rank. Automatic significance selection and a separate output-factor cap are unsupported.

rotation.description: Explicitly select no rotation. Native default is Varimax; do not preserve it on a new node. Varimax and Quartimax are outside this proposed first slice.
